title: 怒濤の恩返しラッシュ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out on a run…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right! The shelf's good as new! It shouldn't give ya any trouble now.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Sorry for making you help me when you should be training, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Aw, it's nothin', ma'am. DIY stuff's my specialty, so fixin' somethin' like this was easy-peasy, lemon-squeezy!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: At least let me give you a li'l something as thanks. How about these strawberry mochi I just made? You can take as many as you like.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Really? Well, then don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So, now I've got a yummy batch of mochi. That was awful nice of her.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'd better savor these while they're fresh, since they're a gift and all. I should probably make some tea to go with 'em.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Hey there, Inari! Thanks again for helping us train the other day!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: We made some inari sushi as a thank-you gift! I hope you like it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whoa, that's super nice of ya! Thanks so much.

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: Inari, I wanted to thank you for helping me look for my contact lens the other day. Here, I made you some dango!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: O-oh, uh, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Student D
text_block_list.text: Inari! Thanks for helping me find a home for that stray cat! Have these rice balls as a treat!

text_block_list.name: Student E
text_block_list.text: Thanks for treating me to lunch the other day, Inari! It's not much, but I made this oden stew, just for you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the heck's goin' on here? Why's everyone off-loadin' food on me?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Can't help but think it's been orchestrated! But they gotta stop—no way I can stomach all this!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Er, you look like you have a lot on your hands already, so I can just make this for you again another day…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, you come back with that! Don't get the wrong idea!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I wasn't raised to be rude and unappreciative of other people's gifts! It doesn't matter how much food you've got! Fork it over!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Ooh! That's the Inari we know and love!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heh. Now how should I go about eatin' it all?
choice_data_list: Let's stuff our faces as fast as possible!
How about we share the food with everyone?
You should train first to work up an appetite!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Nice idea! By the time our brains catch up with the fact that we're full, we'll have already moved on to our post-meal tea!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Time to eat fast and enjoy every split second of this!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Pheeew! That was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Wow! You really ate everything! But… Are you feeling okay, Inari?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah! That was a literal piece of cake! That fried tofu skin was real flavorful, and the kelp filling in the rice balls was tasty too…

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Wow, you're incredible! You really did savor everything!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm on cloud nine after eatin' all this good food ya made for me! I'm ready to give it my all today, too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Urp… That was… real tasty…

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: I-Inari? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah… So yummy… Thanks for… the food…

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: I-Inariii!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One may have eaten everything that was gifted to her, but it kills her appetite for the next two days.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Now there's an idea! Let's have ourselves a picnic!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Oh, should I get some drinks, then? I can get a blanket for us to sit on too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That'd be great, thanks! Feel free to invite more of your friends while you're at it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We end up throwing an impromptu picnic in a corner of the track.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's real smart! This food would go to waste if I don't work up an appetite first!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Don't take it easy on me! I'm expectin' a real challenge, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I throw some intense training at Inari One so she'll be nice and hungry, and she manages to eat everything up with a huge smile on her face.
